task_intent: Create an illustrated educational presentation explaining Whop business workflows.

searches.query: Whop product storefront with membership pricing and purchase button
Whop courses lesson viewer with curriculum and video
Whop team members settings with roles and invite member
Whop support chat conversation with a customer
Whop resolution center dispute case refund request details
Whop balances payouts withdrawal methods and transaction history
Whop affiliates referral links commission dashboard
Whop Content Rewards campaign details submissions and rewards

notes: All selected images are Whop web screens, inspected visually; no iOS screenshots selected.
Downloaded source bytes are retained without resizing, cropping, UI edits, or footer changes.
Capture dates are unknown. Dates visible inside UI are not assumed to be capture dates. Current product availability is unverified.
One distinct screenshot is assigned to each teaching use; do not reuse screenshots across learning slides.
gaps: Dedicated Ads campaign setup, targeting, reporting, and billing not collected. An Ads sidebar label is not evidence of those workflows.
No successful payout or payout-destination setup screenshot collected; available evidence shows balance/transaction and empty withdrawal-history states.
Course evidence is an admin editor view, not a completed learner journey.
Content Rewards video submission form and approval/payment completion not collected.
